items.claim: G19 covers declared groups, members and roots
items.evidence: Read and instrumented current G19. It traverses names_exact plus names_normalised, not r6_focus. Register totals are 45+45 groups, 60+377=437 member visits, 377 unique paths matching scan_bounds.files_hashed=377, and 25 declared-present roots. Instrumentation confirmed all 437 reads in declared member order, all 90 group counts and recomputed distinct-digest counts matching, and exactly 25 root walks in declared order, including required=false sources_31. Full result reported 228292 files walked and seven fixture directories excluded by name. Exclusion names configured are _sandbox, _g18_demo, _redteam_fixtures, _verify, and scratch. Ordinary stdout truncates G19 detail at 110 characters, hiding root and fixture counts. In-memory controls also returned ROOT_ABSENT for a missing sources_31 root and GROUP_DIGESTS_DISAGREE for a false distinct_digests value.
CHECKS registers G22 as REPORTING, not BLOCKING. Its implementation and saved gate output carry SELF_REPORTED_BY_THE_SUBJECT. Its write-based selftest was not independently executed.

Assessment states required_signatures=0, NO_WINDOW_OPENED, and an explicit reason. Independently read the named registry: revision 13, 31 rows, all INSTALLED, zero rows missing owner_signature.value or key_id. Cryptographic signature validity was not tested.
Parsed chapter 14.5 and closeout.still_open. Both contain exactly, in the same order: formal_w0_acceptance, ORIGINAL_ACK, G16b, LICENCE, PIPD-15-VALUESET, R1-ISSUER-REV14.

Read negative_control.py before execution with bytecode writes disabled. It deep-copies the register and changes names_exact[0].members[0].sha256, exactly the field G19 reads. It performs no filesystem write. Baseline returned true/OK; tampered returned false/MEMBER_DIGEST_DRIFT; check_bites=true. G19 now explicitly judges the collected drift list.

notes: No repairs or filesystem writes were performed. Python was unavailable on PATH; execution used installed Codex-runtime Python with bytecode disabled. Both gate entry points were executed through runpy with the requested arguments under an audit guard blocking filesystem mutation and subprocess launch. G22 normally launches a selftest that writes and restores artifacts, so unrestricted reproduction of the maker's two commands remains NOT_VERIFIABLE. Guarded round verdict: VERDICT PASS pass=16/18 blocking_fail=0 open_reporting=2 hygiene=0. Guarded payload verdict: VERDICT PASS pass=12/13 blocking_fail=0 open_reporting=1 hygiene=0. Both exited 0. Payload scope excludes G11, G13, G16a, G16b, and G19; exclusions exist in the internal report but are NOT announced in ordinary stdout. Round and payload gate sources match after line-ending normalization. The staged saved report records full scope, not payload scope. out/GATE_R13_SELFTEST.json remains historical: it still records the old three-r6-copy G19 result and DID_NOT_FIRE; it is not evidence of the current implementation. Overall PASS means no verified item failed under the brief's rules; item 9 remains NOT_VERIFIABLE, and this is not formal_w0_acceptance.
